Thank you for your interest in joining my laboratory through the International Graduate
Program (IGP).

I welcome inquiries from students whose academic interests are closely related to my
research. I particularly welcome inquiries from prospective PhD students, as well as
prospective master's students who are strongly research-oriented and are considering
continuing to doctoral studies in the future. Before contacting me, please read the
information below carefully.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Before you email
Please make sure your interests overlap with my current work, and include the materials
listed in section 2 in a **single** email. Applications that clearly show research fit are
much more likely to receive a reply.
:::

---

## 1. Research fit

Before sending an email, please make sure that your research interests are clearly connected
to my current work. I encourage you to read several of my recent papers on the
[Research page](research.html) and to explain specifically why you are interested in my
research group.

## 2. What to include in your email

When contacting me for the first time, please include the following information in a single
email:

- your full name and current affiliation
- the degree program you wish to apply for
- your academic background and research interests
- a brief explanation of why you want to work with me
- your CV
- your academic transcript
- your English test score, if available
- a brief research proposal or statement of purpose

Please write your email clearly and concisely.

## 3. Important note

Please note that contacting me does not guarantee supervision or admission. Any decision
depends on the match between your interests and my research, my supervisory capacity, and the
official admission process of the university.

## 4. Official application requirements

The information on this page is only intended as guidance for students who wish to contact me
in advance. For official eligibility requirements, application procedures, and deadlines,
please make sure to consult the university's official IGP website:

- [International Graduate Program — Institute of Science Tokyo](https://admissions.isct.ac.jp/en/013/graduate/programs/science-and-engineering)

## 5. Response policy

Because I receive many inquiries, I may not be able to reply to every email. I am more likely
to respond to applicants whose research interests closely match my work and whose emails
include the materials listed above.
